name: Netram
subtitle: AI Inspection & Real-Time CCTV Surveillance Platform
summary: National-level Smart India Hackathon platform for the Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment. Real-time CCTV streaming, surprise inspection scheduling, WebRTC video conferencing, and AI compliance analytics.
challenge: The Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment (DoSJE) required an unbiased, automated auditing system to monitor distributed welfare centers across India without predictability or human tampering.
features: Real-Time CCTV Ingestion: Low-latency RTSP-to-WebRTC stream pipeline supporting 30+ concurrent inspection cameras.
Surprise Audit Dispatcher: Cryptographic scheduling algorithm generating non-predictable audit alerts for inspection officers.
Peer-to-Peer Video Conferencing: Encrypted WebRTC audio and video channels for live verification between central authorities and local nodes.
Automated Compliance Classifier: Computer vision models analyzing video feeds for protocol deviations and timestamp authenticity.

name: Plantexa
subtitle: Two-Stage Deep Learning Plant Disease Diagnosis & Agriculture AI
summary: A production-ready Streamlit web application that first validates whether an uploaded image is a plant leaf, then detects plant leaf diseases using a TensorFlow MobileNetV2 architecture. Includes detailed disease guidance and an agriculture-only AI assistant powered by the NVIDIA API.
challenge: Real-world field images of crops frequently contain non-foliar noise (soil, hands, tools, or backgrounds) that cause standard single-stage models to produce false-positive disease classifications.
features: Two-Stage Neural Pipeline: Strict leaf-vs-non-leaf validation gatekeeper before activating disease classification.
TensorFlow MobileNetV2 Model: Edge-optimized transfer learning model with process-level caching for rapid inference.
Multi-Format Vision Pipeline: Full support for JPG, JPEG, PNG, WEBP, BMP, GIF, TIFF, HEIC, and HEIF images resized to 224 x 224.
Top-3 Diagnostic Ranking: Calibrated probability confidence scores across top-3 disease predictions.
Agronomy Knowledge Base: Integrated diagnostic database covering pathology symptoms, root causes, treatments, and prevention protocols.
NVIDIA API Agriculture Assistant: Context-aware conversational AI with session memory strictly restricted to agricultural topics.
Sidebar-Free Streamlit Architecture: Mobile-first ergonomic layout with chat-style assistant input and modular decoupled prediction logic.

name: Prodexa
subtitle: Product Data Aggregator & Multi-Source Curator
summary: A Flask-based web application that scrapes, curates, and manages product data from multiple e-commerce sources. Provides user authentication, personalized product management, and an intuitive dashboard for browsing and saving products.
challenge: E-commerce product listings across multiple third-party marketplaces feature inconsistent schemas, unstable formatting, and strict anti-scraping defenses, requiring resilient automated curation and persistent user workspaces.
features: Automated Web Scraping: Resilient scraping workers ingesting catalog listings from multiple e-commerce websites.
Intelligent Data Curation: Automated cleaning, schema normalization, and standardized product taxonomies.
User Authentication & Sessions: Secure user registration and login workflows with password validation and encrypted sessions.
Personalized Product Management: User dashboards to bookmark, organize, and manage curated items per account.
Parametric Search & Filter: Multi-attribute parametric search to filter products across categories and price bands.
Responsive Dynamic Dashboard: Mobile-first dashboard layout with dedicated product detail views.
Advanced Security Architecture: Dynamic rate-limiting, IP abuse tracking, password reset email workflows, and server-side image CAPTCHAs.
PostgreSQL Persistence: High-reliability relational persistence powered by Supabase with B-Tree indexing.

name: Aptixa
subtitle: Mobile-First Placement Preparation & Quiz Platform
summary: An all-in-one, mobile-first Placement Preparation & Quiz Platform designed to empower students and job aspirants preparing for campus placements, competitive exams (Bank PO, SSC, CAT, GATE, Railways), and technical interviews.
challenge: Aspirants preparing for high-stakes placement rounds lack unified, mobile-friendly platforms that pair textbook-grade quantitative aptitude curriculum with proctored timed simulations and diagnostic feedback.
features: Complete R.S. Aggarwal Integration: Digital coverage of R.S. Aggarwal's Quantitative Aptitude textbook across 39 chapters and 4,060+ objective-type questions.
Verified Solutions & Formulas: Step-by-step verified answer keys, detailed mathematical explanations, and formula reference sheets.
Mobile-First Architecture: Touch-optimized, responsive quiz runner built with React and Vite for smooth performance on handheld devices.
Competitive Exam Coverage: Targeted practice modules tailored for campus recruitment, Bank PO, SSC, CAT, GATE, and Railways.
Proctored Timed Testing: Dynamic countdown timers and anti-tamper sessions simulating real placement assessment environments.
Scalable Express Backend: Express REST API layer managing candidate progress, quiz sessions, and question taxonomies.
